clinician.trajectory_summary: A 64-year-old diabetic and hypertensive man presented with COVID-19 pneumonia confirmed by SARS-CoV-2 PCR and bilateral lung infiltrates, with initial hypoxia. On day four, neurological deterioration with confusion and decreased GCS was noted. Brain CT on day four revealed hypodensities in the left basal ganglia and right caudate nucleus compatible with ischemic stroke. The patient was treated with aspirin and continued statin and antihypertensives. Despite ICU care, his condition worsened and he died on day 27.

Neurological deterioration on day four with confusion and GCS drop to 10/15
Brain CT on day four showing hypodense lesions in left basal ganglia and right caudate nucleus consistent with ischemic stroke
Patient received aspirin and continued statin and antihypertensives after ischemic stroke diagnosis
Patient deteriorated over hospital stay and died on day 27 despite care
